name: EngageBay
description_en:
EngageBay offers an all-in-one suite as well as separate Marketing, Sales & CRM and Service products. Its automation value is the connection between a contact conversation and CRM work: a qualifying event can lead to a message, task, owner assignment or deal update. Buying the suite does not remove the need to check which module and plan expose each operation.

The help center makes a useful terminology distinction: an Automation starts from an event, while a Workflow is a set of steps started by execution. That distinction matters when an operator wants to enroll an existing contact or stop a follow-up sequence. The profile below focuses on this operational handoff and its failure cases. No account, sending reputation or CRM outcome was tested.
description_zh:
EngageBay 同时提供一体化套件，以及独立的 Marketing、Sales & CRM、Service 产品。其自动化价值在于连接联系人沟通与 CRM 工作：合格事件可引出消息、任务、负责人分配或商机更新。采购套件后，仍需核对每项操作属于哪个模块及套餐。

帮助中心对术语有实用区分：Automation 从事件开始，Workflow 则是通过执行启动的一组步骤。操作者需要纳入已有联系人或停止跟进序列时，这个区别很重要。以下稿件聚焦这种操作衔接及失败情形，未测试账户、发件信誉或 CRM 效果。

core_features.name_zh: 事件驱动的 CRM 动作
core_features.explanation_en: Sales automations can respond to deal changes and update owners or tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 销售自动化可响应商机变化，更新负责人或任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Use a workflow when selected contacts need an operator-started sequence of steps.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选定联系人需要由操作者启动一组步骤时，可使用 Workflow。

core_features.explanation_en: Reply detection can lead to Remove from sequence after prerequisites are configured.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置前提满足后，可由回复检测引出 Remove from sequence。

core_features.explanation_en: Automation and Workflow have distinct documented bulk removal operations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档为 Automation 与 Workflow 分别提供批量移除操作。

en: Editorial fit: a small sales and marketing team evaluating shared contact, deal and follow-up work in one suite.
Editorial fit: an operator needing manually initiated CRM processing alongside event-driven sequences.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：希望在同一套件中处理联系人、商机与跟进的销售营销小团队。
编辑判断的适用场景：既需要事件触发序列，也需要手动启动 CRM 处理的运营人员。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Select all-in-one or the specific Bay and confirm the needed automation entitlement.
steps.zh: 选择一体化或具体 Bay，并确认所需自动化权限。

steps.en: Define the trigger and an expected contact/deal update for one synthetic record.
steps.zh: 为一条合成记录定义触发事件及预期联系人／商机更新。

steps.en: Test reply detection and removal against the actual sequence timing using internal addresses.
steps.zh: 使用内部地址，按真实序列时序测试回复检测与移除。

steps.en: Inspect daily allowance and validation-credit needs before importing a larger permitted audience.
steps.zh: 导入较大许可受众前，检查每日额度与验证积分需求。

items.en: Re-entry, in-flight timers after Mark as Draft, rollback and provider retry behavior remain unverified.
items.zh: 重入、Mark as Draft 后的在途计时、回滚及服务商重试行为仍未核实。

items.en: Removing a contact from processing and suppressing all future messages are separate operations.
items.zh: 移出联系人当前执行与抑制全部未来消息属于不同操作。

items.en: Module navigation and billing selections require account confirmation.
items.zh: 模块导航与账期选择需要在账户中确认。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: All-in-one page: Free $0 with 250 contacts. Paid contact tiers: Basic 500, Growth 5,000, Pro 10,000. Observed per-user/month card groups show Basic $14.99/$13.79/$12.74, Growth $64.99/$59.79/$55.24 and Pro $119.99/$110.39/$101.99; the extracted billing toggle is insufficient to map all groups to terms. The first Basic card explicitly says paid yearly. No normalized starting quote is assigned. Standalone Marketing/Sales prices differ. Validation credits and daily sending restrictions need separate assessment.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 一体化定价页：Free 为零美元、250 联系人。付费联系人档位为 Basic 500、Growth 5,000、Pro 10,000。实读按用户／月的卡片组分别显示 Basic 14.99／13.79／12.74 美元、Growth 64.99／59.79／55.24 美元、Pro 119.99／110.39／101.99 美元；提取结果不足以将全部价格组准确映射到账期。第一张 Basic 卡明确写按年付费。不指定标准化起价。独立 Marketing／Sales 产品价格不同，验证积分及每日发送限制也需单独评估。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Choose the product and execution model first
sections.title_zh: 先选择产品与执行模型
sections.en: The all-in-one pricing page is not the price list for every standalone Bay. Within the documentation, Automation means event-triggered processing; Workflow means manually executed processing. The detailed guides carry Marketing labels but use Sales dashboard navigation, so verify the actual account UI rather than copying the breadcrumb as a guaranteed menu path. For an evaluation, list the desired operation and owning record type: contact, company or deal.
sections.zh: 一体化定价页不能当作所有独立 Bay 的价目表。文档中 Automation 表示事件触发处理，Workflow 表示手动执行处理。详细指南带有 Marketing 分类标签，却使用 Sales 仪表盘导航，因此应核对实际账户界面，不能把分类路径当成保证存在的菜单路径。评估时可逐项列出操作及其记录类型：联系人、公司或商机。

sections.title_en: Existing contacts need an explicit way in
sections.title_zh: 已有联系人需要明确的入场方式
sections.en: The enrollment FAQ says contacts cannot be added directly to an Automation. Its trigger must occur, such as adding the configured tag. A manually executed Workflow is the documented alternative for selected contacts. In a hypothetical sales handoff, separate the tag that records qualification from the task or owner update that follows it. Test an already-qualified record and a newly-qualified record separately; the public FAQ does not establish automatic replay of an old event.
sections.zh: 入场 FAQ 说明不能直接把联系人加入 Automation，需要发生其触发事件，例如添加所配置的标签。对于选定联系人，文档提供的替代方式是手动执行 Workflow。假设设计销售交接，应区分记录资格的标签与之后的任务或负责人更新。分别测试原本已合格与刚刚合格的记录；公开 FAQ 并未确认会自动重放旧事件。

sections.title_en: Stopping on reply depends on receiving the reply
sections.title_zh: 按回复停止的前提是系统收到回复
sections.en: The sequence-removal guide requires forwarding incoming replies from the receiving mailbox and configuring the sequence reply-to address. The automation then uses Joins a sequence, Has Subscriber Replied and Remove from sequence. The condition waits for a configured period; after that without a reply it takes No and exits the automation. An editorial test should include a reply received before the next scheduled follow-up and one outside the evaluation window. No mailbox forwarding was configured during this research.
sections.zh: 序列移除指南要求从接收邮箱转发回复，并配置序列的 reply-to 地址。随后自动化使用 Joins a sequence、Has Subscriber Replied 和 Remove from sequence。条件会等待指定时间，期间没有回复则走 No 并退出自动化。建议测试下一封跟进前收到的回复，以及检测窗口之外的回复。本次研究未配置任何邮箱转发。

sections.title_en: Remove a run separately from suppressing email
sections.title_zh: 区分移出执行与抑制邮件
sections.en: Automation removal can use a filtered bulk action, or a Workflow with Remove from Automation executed against selected contacts. Workflow removal has its own Contacts bulk operation. These procedures remove the current processing context; they do not document a permanent ban on future trigger entry. Separately, the exclusion FAQ instructs adding the tag Unsubscribe with an uppercase U. Verify the intended suppression scope before a migration rather than assuming any similarly named tag has the same effect.
sections.zh: 移出 Automation 可使用筛选后的批量操作，或创建含 Remove from Automation 的 Workflow，再对选定联系人执行。移出 Workflow 则有自己的 Contacts 批量操作。这些程序处理当前执行上下文，并未说明会永久禁止未来触发入场。另外，排除邮件的 FAQ 要求添加首字母 U 大写的 Unsubscribe 标签。迁移前应核对预期抑制范围，不能认为任何近似命名标签都有同样效果。

sections.title_en: A purchased allowance does not remove the daily limit
sections.title_zh: 套餐额度不会消除每日限制
sections.en: The broadcast FAQ documents a list-size check against the daily email allowance and describes reset as 24 hours after the last sent email. The warmup article describes additional restrictions for new clients and reputation-dependent increases. A launch with a larger purchased allowance can still need a smaller initial recipient group. Confirm the account’s actual daily cap before scheduling; the examples in the guide are not a promised cap or guaranteed warmup timetable for every customer.
sections.zh: 广播 FAQ 说明会按每日邮件额度检查名单大小，并将重置描述为最后一封邮件发出后的 24 小时。预热文章说明新客户还有额外限制，提额取决于信誉。即使已购买较大套餐，首次启动仍可能需要更小的收件群。排期前应确认账户实际每日上限；指南示例不是对每位客户承诺的额度或保证完成的预热时间表。

sections.title_en: Separate processing, delivery and address validation
sections.title_zh: 区分执行、投递与地址验证
sections.en: The automation report distinguishes Active and Completed contacts from recipients, delivered messages, opens and bounces. A completed contact is not proof that a message reached an inbox or produced a sale. Address validation is another operation: the help center requires purchased validation credits and a Contacts bulk Validate Emails action, then completion notification. Budget for that separately and inspect the actual failing stage before re-running an entire journey. Validation is not evidence of permission to email a person.
sections.zh: 自动化报告区分 Active、Completed 联系人，以及收件人、已投递消息、打开和退信。联系人执行完成，不代表消息进入收件箱或产生销售。地址验证是另一项操作：帮助中心要求购买验证积分，再在 Contacts 中批量执行 Validate Emails，并等待完成通知。应单独估算这项费用，重跑整条旅程前先找出真正失败的阶段。验证地址也不代表已取得向其发信的许可。

sections.title_en: Compare seats and entitlements, not a single teaser price
sections.title_zh: 比较席位与权限，而不只看起价
sections.en: The all-in-one cards show a Free plan with 250 contacts, then Basic, Growth and Pro contact tiers of 500, 5,000 and 10,000. Paid amounts are per user per month, and the extracted page contains multiple price groups whose billing selection is not reliably exposed. Marketing Automation appears in the Growth and Pro card summaries. A flattened feature matrix includes labels without dependable inclusion icons, so this draft does not turn every listed label into a Free entitlement. Get a quote for the selected product, seat count, term and sending needs.
sections.zh: 一体化套餐卡显示 Free 含 250 联系人，随后 Basic、Growth、Pro 分别为 500、5,000、10,000 联系人档位。付费金额按用户／月表示，提取页面包含多组价格，但账期选择未可靠呈现。Growth 与 Pro 套餐卡摘要列有 Marketing Automation。扁平化功能矩阵包含标签，却无法可靠识别权限图标，因此本稿不会把所有列出的标签都当成 Free 权益。应按所选产品、席位数、期限和发送需求取得报价。

seo.title_zh: EngageBay：CRM 自动化、工作流与回复式跟进
seo.description_en: Evaluate EngageBay trigger enrollment, manual workflows, reply detection, contact removal, daily send limits and suite pricing.
seo.description_zh: 评估 EngageBay 触发入场、手动流程、回复检测、联系人移除、每日发送限制与套件定价。
seo.primary_intent: Understand EngageBay marketing and CRM workflow behavior
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户流程、邮箱转发、联系人验证或测试发送。

research_gaps.zh: 具体账期映射、联系人计费状态规则、短信费用与地区可用性仍未解决。

research_gaps.en: Interface languages, self-hosting rights and independent performance outcomes remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 界面语言、自托管权利及独立效果仍未核实。
